- **Description states when to use it:** The front-matter `description` begins "Use when adopting Habeas in an existing codebase, when validation reports uncovered items across most of a project's code, or when the user asks for a requirements coverage audit." That is phrased in terms of the user's task.

All three exist as sibling directories under `assets/skills`.

It is a numbered checklist of steps 1–9, with a note on which steps repeat per area. I read the short framing paragraph as consistent with "opens with its workflow".
- **Referenced material states when to read it:** The only referenced file is `../habeas-requirements/references/distributed-requirements.md`, which exists. The skill ties it to a situation: "When a convention applies on its own at many sites... propose a distributed requirement... read" that file. That is a statement of when to read it.

There are no violation matches to judge, and no gaps.
